notes: 流光背景：卡片改为半透白叠层（iOS 26 下 Material 会渲染成液态玻璃的灰膜，卡片看起来是一块实心灰板）；背景色团饱和度按原版截图重校；默认卡片透明度回到 70%
notesEn: Fluid background: cards now use a translucent white layer instead of Material (on iOS 26 Material renders as Liquid Glass, making cards look like solid grey slabs); blob saturation recalibrated against the original; default card transparency back to 70%
